veranderings.voor: want oorskryf is nie navorsing nie
veranderings.na: want afskryf is nie navorsing nie
veranderings.rede: In school Afrikaans 'afskryf' is the usual word for copying someone else's text, while 'oorskryf' can also read as 'rewrite' or 'overwrite'.

vlae.teks: Skryf jou biografie in tydsorde van haar vroeë jare af.
vlae.rede: 'haar' (and the 'sy' that follows) comes before the lesson has said the person is a woman; the only antecedent is 'een werklike mens', which Afrikaans normally takes up with 'hy'. Fixing it needs a content decision (say she is a woman, or use a neutral reference), so it is flagged rather than changed.

beskerm_bedenkings.woord: primêre bron - "... Dit bly 'n primêre bron, ook as sy dit jare later vertel."
beskerm_bedenkings.rede: Read alone as a glossary entry, 'sy' has no clear antecedent: the sentence before names 'iemand' and 'die mens self', neither of them marked as female. Left unchanged because the wording is decided; noted for a person.
